## What is OpenMA?

**OpenMA** (Open Managed Agents) is the infrastructure layer for AI agents. You bring the harness — the loop that decides what the model does next — and OpenMA takes care of everything else: durable sessions, sandboxed code execution, tool calls, semantic memory, secret-safe credentials, and crash recovery.

Use the SDKs you know: OpenMA supports **Claude Managed Agents** and **OpenAI Agents API**. Deploy on **any cloud** — self-hosted **Node + Docker**, Cloudflare, or the hosted product at [openma.ai](https://openma.ai/). Available capabilities depend on the harness, sandbox adapter, and deployment target.

For the KHA CLI, self-hosted Node also has an **experimental, opt-in [Kimi Hosted Agents subset](/build/kimi-hosted-agents/)** ([中文指南](/zh-cn/build/kimi-hosted-agents/)). It is disabled by default and is not exposed by hosted Cloudflare; check the supported operations and verification limits before migrating.

## Why OpenMA?

Most agent frameworks tell you *how* to build an agent — the loop, the prompt format, the orchestration shape. OpenMA is different: it stays out of the harness and instead provides what every long-running agent needs but is painful to build.

<CardGrid>
  <Card title="Durable sessions" icon="approve-check">
    Append-only event log per session. Resume from anywhere; survive restarts and crashes.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Sandboxed execution" icon="seti:docker">
    Tool calls run in per-session sandboxes. Pick Docker, E2B, Daytona, Cloudflare Containers, and more.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Vault-backed credentials" icon="seti:lock">
    Secrets never enter the sandbox. An outbound proxy injects auth headers per-host so tools can hit private APIs without ever seeing the key.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Built-in memory" icon="document">
    Per-agent semantic memory across sessions so agents can pick up where they left off.
  </Card>
  <Card title="MCP, everywhere" icon="puzzle">
    Connect any MCP server and OpenMA auto-generates `mcp_*` tools the model can call.
  </Card>
  <Card title="Three integrations, day one" icon="rocket">
    Publish agents into Linear (assignable issues), GitHub (PRs), and Slack (channels) with OAuth-managed auth.
  </Card>
</CardGrid>
